HELP.TITLE: How can we help you?
HELP.INTRO: Find answers about your account, schedules, and enrollment.
HELP.GUIDED_DESCRIPTION: Choose what you want to do and we will walk you through each step.
HELP.NO_RESULTS: No matching questions found. Try different search terms.
HELP.QUICK_LINKS_DESCRIPTION: Go directly to schedules and payments.

REGISTRATION.TITLE: Register
REGISTRATION.DESCRIPTION: Register and get your account ready to get started.

1.TITLE: Open the registration form
1.DESCRIPTION: Select the registration button on the log-in screen to open the form.

2.TITLE: Enter your information
2.DESCRIPTION: Enter your name, email address, and a password. Use an email account you can access.

3.TITLE: Choose your user type
3.DESCRIPTION: Select whether you are a student, teacher, or external user. Enter the student ID or ID number requested for your user type.

4.TITLE: Submit the form
4.DESCRIPTION: Review your information and select Sign up. You can then log in with your email and password.

LOGIN.TITLE: Log in
LOGIN.DESCRIPTION: Learn how to access an existing account.

1.TITLE: Open the log-in screen
1.DESCRIPTION: Go to the log-in screen. If you are on the registration form, select Back to log in.

2.TITLE: Enter your account email
2.DESCRIPTION: In the Email field, enter the address you used when you registered.

3.TITLE: Enter your password
3.DESCRIPTION: Type your password in the password field. You can use the eye icon to check what you entered.

4.TITLE: Access your account
4.DESCRIPTION: Select Log in. If you cannot access your account, check your email and password or contact your institution's administration.

ENROLLMENT.TITLE: Choose a schedule and enroll
ENROLLMENT.DESCRIPTION: Review available options and complete your enrollment.

1.TITLE: Browse the schedules
1.DESCRIPTION: Open Schedules to see the days, times, capacity, and availability of each option.

2.TITLE: Choose an available option
2.DESCRIPTION: Compare the days and times, then select a schedule that works for you. Full schedules cannot be selected.

3.TITLE: Review the details
3.DESCRIPTION: On the next screen, confirm the schedule details before continuing to the enrollment payment.

4.TITLE: Complete the payment
4.DESCRIPTION: Select an available payment method and follow the instructions to finish enrolling. You can check your schedule in this section afterward.

PAYMENT.TITLE: Make the monthly payment
PAYMENT.DESCRIPTION: Follow the steps to select a payment method and submit your payment.

1.TITLE: Open the payments section
1.DESCRIPTION: Select Payments from the menu to view the monthly payment form and the amount for your user type.

2.TITLE: Choose how to pay
2.DESCRIPTION: Select card or PayPal in the Payment method field. The form will show the corresponding options.

3.TITLE: Confirm the payment
3.DESCRIPTION: Review your selected method and select Pay. Wait for confirmation before closing or leaving the page.

CONTRACTS.TITLE: View contracts
CONTRACTS.DESCRIPTION: Find the contracts section and learn where to get assistance.

1.TITLE: Open Contracts
1.DESCRIPTION: Select Contracts from the main menu to access the section.

2.TITLE: Ask for information if needed
2.DESCRIPTION: If your contract details are not available in the app yet, contact your institution's administration.

QUESTIONS.CREATE_ACCOUNT: How do I create an account?
QUESTIONS.LOGIN: What should I do if I cannot log in?
QUESTIONS.FIND_SCHEDULE: Where can I view the schedules?
QUESTIONS.ENROLL: How do I enroll in a schedule?
QUESTIONS.PAY_ENROLLMENT: How do I pay for an enrollment?
QUESTIONS.MONTHLY_PAYMENT: Where do I make the monthly payment?
QUESTIONS.CONTRACT_STATUS: Where can I check my contract?

ANSWERS.CREATE_ACCOUNT: Select Register on the home screen and complete the form with your information.
ANSWERS.LOGIN: Check that your email and password are correct. If the problem continues, ask your institution's administration for help.
ANSWERS.FIND_SCHEDULE: Open the Schedules section to browse available schedules or view the schedule you are already enrolled in.
ANSWERS.ENROLL: In Schedules, choose an available schedule and follow the steps to complete enrollment and payment.
ANSWERS.PAY_ENROLLMENT: Select the available schedule you prefer and complete the payment process. The payment screen shows the available methods.
ANSWERS.MONTHLY_PAYMENT: Open the Payments section from the menu to view and make your monthly payment.
ANSWERS.CONTRACT_STATUS: Open Contracts from the menu. If the information you need is not available yet, contact your institution's administration.

CONTRACTS.POOL_RULES_INTRO: According to the aquatic facilities use form and contract:

POOL_RULES.SHOWER: Showering before entering the water is required.
POOL_RULES.SWIMWEAR: Appropriate swimwear (no shorts or street clothes) and a swimming cap are required.
POOL_RULES.FOOD_AND_GLASS: Eating food or drinking alcoholic beverages is prohibited, as is using glass containers in the area.
POOL_RULES.FOLLOW_STAFF: Always follow the instructions of lifeguards and instructors.
POOL_RULES.PAYMENT_DUE: Monthly payments must be kept up to date within the first five days of each month.

CONTRACTS.RESPONSIBILITY_TEXT: Participation in aquatic activities is voluntary, and the participant declares that they are acting with full use of their faculties. The participant also declares that they are physically fit to practice swimming and releases the Universidad Católica Santo Domingo (UCSD) and its staff from legal liability for accidents, injuries, or events arising from the use of the facilities, except when attributable to gross negligence by the institution. The participant also agrees to comply with the internal rules.
